messages:
Marta Ops: heads up — vendor paperwork doesn't match the PO for the H100 top-off. AWB on docs is different from the carrier tracking. can someone confirm before customs hits it? :eyes:
Jordan (Vendor): ugh sorry about that, our packing slip printer pulled the wrong AWB. actual AWB is `766012345678`. still 10 units (S/Ns included). ETA AMS 2025-03-05. I'll reissue paperwork if needed.
Sam Procurement: can you confirm invoice id `INV-8892` amount? freight line looks like $12,300 with carrier "NordEx" but AWS shows freight via FastFreight. need to know who eats reprint costs.
Jordan (Vendor): invoice is correct for units and freight we quoted, carrier change was internal. we can credit $1,200 for paperwork error if you need us to reprint and refile docs. alternatively we can consolidate with the second AWB to avoid two customs fees.
Ryan Logistics: hold any clearance until we have the corrected docs. pls don't auto-clear. need pallet photos and the printed AWB so customs can be updated. also one unit flagged DOA at staging (unit 3). Jordan, can you confirm serial and accept RMA?
Jordan (Vendor): confirmed DOA for S/N H100-003 — we accept. I'll start RMA flow and confirm pickup window. re: consolidation — we can merge to single AWB but need signoff from procurement.
RMA Bot: Created RMA #RMA-2025-77 for serial `H100-003`. Pickup requested within 24h once RMA accepted by vendor. Tracking stub: `RMA-STUB-77`.
Marta Ops: proposed split: vendor covers paperwork reprint / customs surcharge for duplicate AWBs, Redwood covers expedited uplift if we need air rebook. Sam, ok to approve vendor credit and up to $2,000 expedite cap?
Sam Procurement: approve vendor credit $1,200 for paperwork. Redwood approves expedite uplift up to $2,000. vendor to confirm final numbers before we book.
Jordan (Vendor): thanks — we'll reprint, consolidate docs into AWB `766012345678` and issue a credit memo for $1,200 against `INV-8892`. I will email forwarder (tracy@fast-freight.com) to coordinate rebook and pickup for RMA.
Ryan Logistics: please add customs reference `FreightClaim: PO-5542` on updated paperwork. I also need high-res pallet photos, closeups of label and the DOA unit — upload to our drive and paste link.
Marta Ops: perfect. Ryan pls upload the photos and update the ticket; I'll ping compliance to hold clearance until refiled. Jordan ping me when forwarder confirms booking. :thumbsup:
Ryan Logistics: Photos uploaded: https://drive.internal/redwood/procure/1749532100/photos (pallets + DOA closeups). I added a note in the freight ticket with forwarder contact and RMA stub.
Jordan (Vendor): forwarder confirmed pickup tomorrow 09:00 CET and will hand new docs to AMS customs broker. I'll send the credit memo by EOD.
Marta Ops: closing loop — thanks all. I'll put the cost-share in the expense request and flag `INV-8892` for amendment. Ryan keep monitoring until cleared.
